description: Minimal Plantly hooks: concise startup context and small destructive-command guard. No Stop loops or lint on every tool.

hooks.command: python -c "import pathlib,sys,runpy;parts=[pathlib.Path.cwd(),*pathlib.Path.cwd().parents];files=[p/'tools'/'agentic'/'hooks.py' for p in parts];matches=[p for p in files if p.is_file()];assert matches,'Plantly hooks.py missing from cwd ancestor';sys.argv=[str(matches[0]),'start'];runpy.run_path(str(matches[0]),run_name='__main__')"
hooks.commandWindows: py -3 -c "import pathlib,sys,runpy;parts=[pathlib.Path.cwd(),*pathlib.Path.cwd().parents];files=[p/'tools'/'agentic'/'hooks.py' for p in parts];matches=[p for p in files if p.is_file()];assert matches,'Plantly hooks.py missing from cwd ancestor';sys.argv=[str(matches[0]),'start'];runpy.run_path(str(matches[0]),run_name='__main__')"
